summary: Keep Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch up, Mind Blast on cooldown, Mind Flay as filler. Devouring Plague and Shadow Word: Death on cooldown.
_max_rank_note: Only SW:Pain (25368) confirmed against live TBC Anniversary log abilities. Mind Blast/Mind Flay/VT/Devouring Plague/SW:Death IDs were unverified guesses (live logs show e.g. Mind Flay 29570, not 25387) and were removed to avoid flagging correct max-rank casts. Re-add when confirmed from a player shadow priest's casts.

Smite.note: a holy nuke  -  Shadowform spriests should not be casting Smite

Holy Fire.note: a holy nuke  -  wrong school for Shadowform

advisory: Mind Flay is filler only  -  never clip a Mind Blast or refresh window for it. Vampiric Touch and Shadow Word: Pain should have near-100% uptime.
